responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible character display interface used by the terminal abstraction layer. It exports a single Write procedure for sending one character to standard output, including the legacy conventions for newline and destructive backspace handling.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Display pair: it publishes the Write(ch: CHAR) interface and its Logitech-compatible character semantics, while Display.mod contains the actual stdout translation logic.
